name: Bihar Police Constable
fullName: Bihar Police / Bihar Special Armed Police Constable Recruitment (CSBC)
conductingBody: Central Selection Board of Constable (CSBC), Bihar
frequency: Roughly once a year (plus smaller cadre-specific drives)
approxCandidates: ≈17–18 lakh applicants for the 19,838-post GD drive (Advt 01/2025); 0.6–1.3 lakh for the smaller 2026 drives
eligibility: Class 12 (Intermediate) pass; 18–25 yrs (UR male), relaxations for reserved categories and women; Bihar domicile required for reservation benefits

notification.summary: The main GD drive (Advt 01/2025, 19,838 posts; written exam 16 Jul – 3 Aug 2025) ended with the final result on 27 May 2026. In 2026, CSBC held written exams in June for Special Branch Constable (Advt 01/2026, 83 posts), Constable Operator (Advt 02/2026, 993 posts) and Prohibition Constable/Jail Warder/Mobile Squad (Advt 03/2025, 4,236 posts), with results on 18 Aug 2026 (≈27,969 shortlisted for PET/PST). No new large GD constable advertisement had been found as of 10 Oct 2026. Some dates come from news aggregators – confirm on csbc.bihar.gov.in.

pattern.notes: Class 10 (Matric) level, single paper, no negative marking. The written test is qualifying only (30% minimum); the final merit is based on the PET (running, high jump, shot put). CSBC does not publish fixed section-wise counts, so the split shown is the average of recent papers and varies by shift.

trendAnalysis.summary: Based on the Oct-2023 paper (21,391 posts, cancelled after a leak), the Aug-2024 re-exam and the Jul–Aug 2025 shifts (19,838 posts). The paper is easy to moderate and is dominated by General Studies: Social Science and Science together make up about half of it. Bihar-specific GK (history of Magadh, freedom struggle in Bihar, rivers, national parks, state facts) and current affairs of the previous year are consistently high-yield. Maths is basic arithmetic at Class 10 level. Hindi and English test elementary grammar and vocabulary. Because the written test is only qualifying, accuracy across the GS questions is enough to clear it.

resources.notes: CSBC publishes the answer keys (with question booklet series) on csbc.bihar.gov.in after each written exam; full question papers are not archived officially and are available through coaching compilations. No official mock test.

questions.question: What is the correct sandhi-vichchhed (संधि-विच्छेद) of 'हिमालय'?
questions.questionHi: 'हिमालय' का सही संधि-विच्छेद क्या है?
questions.explanation: हिम + आलय: अ + आ = आ (दीर्घ संधि) → हिमालय।

questions.question: Which samas (समास) is used in 'राजपुत्र'?
questions.questionHi: 'राजपुत्र' में कौन-सा समास है?
questions.explanation: राजपुत्र = राजा का पुत्र; 'का' (संबंध कारक) विभक्ति का लोप होने से तत्पुरुष समास।

questions.question: Choose the synonym (पर्यायवाची) of 'पृथ्वी'.
questions.questionHi: 'पृथ्वी' का पर्यायवाची शब्द चुनिए।
questions.explanation: वसुधा = पृथ्वी। वारिद = बादल, विहग = पक्षी, वारि = जल।

questions.question: Choose the antonym (विलोम) of 'सुगम'.
questions.questionHi: 'सुगम' का विलोम शब्द चुनिए।
questions.explanation: सुगम (आसानी से जाने योग्य) का विलोम दुर्गम है; अन्य तीनों समानार्थी हैं।

questions.question: What is the meaning of the idiom 'आँख का तारा'?
questions.questionHi: मुहावरे 'आँख का तारा' का अर्थ क्या है?
questions.explanation: 'आँख का तारा' = अत्यंत प्रिय। उदाहरण: इकलौता बेटा माँ की आँख का तारा होता है।

questions.question: Which of the following works was written by Ramdhari Singh 'Dinkar'?
questions.questionHi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सी रचना रामधारी सिंह 'दिनकर' की है?
questions.explanation: 'रश्मिरथी' दिनकर का खंडकाव्य है। 'कामायनी' जयशंकर प्रसाद, 'मैला आँचल' फणीश्वरनाथ रेणु और 'गबन' प्रेमचंद की रचना है।

questions.question: Fill in the blank: He is ___ honest man.
questions.questionHi: रिक्त स्थान भरें: He is ___ honest man.
questions.explanation: 'Honest' begins with a vowel sound (the 'h' is silent), so the article is 'an'.

questions.question: Fill in the blank: She has been living in Patna ___ 2019.
questions.questionHi: रिक्त स्थान भरें: She has been living in Patna ___ 2019.
questions.explanation: 'Since' is used with a point of time in the perfect continuous tense; 'for' is used with a period of time.

questions.question: Choose the synonym of 'Brave'.
questions.questionHi: 'Brave' का समानार्थी शब्द चुनिए।
questions.explanation: Brave means courageous; timid is its opposite.

questions.question: Choose the antonym of 'Ancient'.
questions.questionHi: 'Ancient' का विलोम शब्द चुनिए।
questions.explanation: Ancient means very old; its opposite is modern. The other three are synonyms.

questions.question: Choose the correctly spelt word.
questions.questionHi: सही वर्तनी वाला शब्द चुनिए।
questions.explanation: The correct spelling is 'necessary', with one 'c' and a double 's'.

questions.question: What is 15% of 240?
An article is sold for ₹540 at a loss of 10%. What is its cost price?
questions.questionHi: एक वस्तु 10% हानि पर ₹540 में बेची जाती है। उसका क्रय मूल्य क्या है?

questions.question: What is the average of 4, 8, 12, 16 and 20?
questions.explanation: Sum = 60; average = 60 / 5 = 12.

questions.question: If A : B = 2 : 3 and B : C = 4 : 5, what is A : C?
questions.questionHi: यदि A : B = 2 : 3 और B : C = 4 : 5 है, तो A : C क्या है?
questions.explanation: A : B : C = 8 : 12 : 15 (making B equal to 12), so A : C = 8 : 15.

questions.question: If 3x − 7 = 11, what is the value of x?
questions.questionHi: यदि 3x − 7 = 11 है, तो x का मान क्या है?

questions.question: What is the perimeter of a rectangle of length 12 cm and breadth 8 cm?
questions.questionHi: 12 सेमी लंबे और 8 सेमी चौड़े आयत का परिमाप क्या है?
questions.explanation: Perimeter = 2(l + b) = 2(12 + 8) = 40 cm. (96 cm² would be the area.)

questions.question: The two perpendicular sides of a right-angled triangle are 6 cm and 8 cm. What is the length of its hypotenuse?
questions.questionHi: एक समकोण त्रिभुज की लंब भुजाएँ 6 सेमी और 8 सेमी हैं। इसका कर्ण कितना है?
questions.explanation: By Pythagoras, hypotenuse = √(6² + 8²) = √100 = 10 cm.

questions.question: What is the SI unit of electrical resistance?
questions.questionHi: विद्युत प्रतिरोध का SI मात्रक क्या है?
questions.explanation: Resistance is measured in ohms (Ω). Volt is the unit of potential difference, ampere of current and watt of power.

questions.question: What is the approximate speed of light in vacuum?
questions.questionHi: निर्वात में प्रकाश की लगभग चाल क्या है?
questions.explanation: Light travels at about 3 × 10⁸ m/s (3 lakh km per second) in vacuum.

questions.question: Which lens is used to correct myopia (short-sightedness)?
questions.questionHi: निकट-दृष्टि दोष (मायोपिया) को ठीक करने के लिए किस लेंस का उपयोग होता है?
questions.explanation: In myopia the image forms in front of the retina; a concave (diverging) lens moves it back onto the retina.

questions.question: Which of the following is a vector quantity?
questions.questionHi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सी सदिश राशि है?
questions.explanation: Velocity has both magnitude and direction; speed, mass and temperature are scalars.

questions.question: What is the pH of pure water at 25 °C?
questions.questionHi: 25 °C पर शुद्ध जल का pH मान क्या होता है?
questions.explanation: Pure water is neutral and has a pH of 7 at 25 °C.

questions.question: Which gas is the most abundant in the Earth's atmosphere?
questions.questionHi: पृथ्वी के वायुमंडल में सबसे अधिक मात्रा में कौन-सी गैस है?
questions.explanation: Nitrogen makes up about 78% of the atmosphere, oxygen about 21%.

questions.question: What is the chemical symbol of sodium?
questions.questionHi: सोडियम का रासायनिक प्रतीक क्या है?
questions.explanation: Sodium's symbol Na comes from its Latin name Natrium. S is sulphur.

questions.question: Rusting of iron requires the presence of:
questions.questionHi: लोहे में जंग लगने के लिए किसकी उपस्थिति आवश्यक है?
questions.explanation: Iron rusts (forms hydrated iron oxide) only when both oxygen (air) and water (moisture) are present.

questions.question: Which cell organelle is called the 'powerhouse of the cell'?
questions.questionHi: कोशिका का कौन-सा अंगक 'कोशिका का ऊर्जा-घर' कहलाता है?
questions.explanation: Mitochondria produce energy (ATP) through cellular respiration.

questions.question: People of which blood group are known as universal donors?
questions.questionHi: किस रक्त समूह वाले व्यक्ति को सर्वदाता कहा जाता है?
questions.explanation: Group O red cells carry neither A nor B antigens, so they can be given to all ABO groups. AB is the universal recipient.

questions.question: Insulin is secreted by which organ?
questions.questionHi: इंसुलिन किस अंग द्वारा स्रावित होता है?
questions.explanation: The beta cells of the islets of Langerhans in the pancreas secrete insulin.

questions.question: In which part of a plant cell does photosynthesis take place?
questions.questionHi: पादप कोशिका के किस भाग में प्रकाश-संश्लेषण होता है?
questions.explanation: Chloroplasts contain chlorophyll, which traps sunlight for photosynthesis.

questions.question: In which year did Mahatma Gandhi launch the Champaran Satyagraha in Bihar?
questions.questionHi: महात्मा गांधी ने बिहार में चंपारण सत्याग्रह किस वर्ष शुरू किया?
questions.explanation: The Champaran Satyagraha against the indigo (tinkathia) system began in 1917 and was Gandhiji's first satyagraha in India.

questions.question: Who founded the Maurya Empire?
questions.questionHi: मौर्य साम्राज्य की स्थापना किसने की?
questions.explanation: Chandragupta Maurya founded the empire around 322 BCE with Chanakya's help; Bimbisara belonged to the earlier Haryanka dynasty.

questions.question: Nalanda Mahavihara is generally believed to have been founded by which ruler?
questions.questionHi: नालंदा महाविहार की स्थापना सामान्यतः किस शासक द्वारा मानी जाती है?
questions.explanation: Nalanda was founded in the 5th century CE by the Gupta ruler Kumaragupta I. Dharmapala of the Pala dynasty founded Vikramshila.

questions.question: Where was Vardhamana Mahavira born?
questions.questionHi: वर्धमान महावीर का जन्म कहाँ हुआ था?
questions.explanation: Mahavira was born at Kundagram near Vaishali. He attained nirvana at Pawapuri; Lumbini is the Buddha's birthplace.

questions.question: Who led the Revolt of 1857 in Bihar from Jagdishpur?
questions.questionHi: 1857 के विद्रोह में बिहार के जगदीशपुर से किसने नेतृत्व किया?
questions.explanation: Babu Kunwar Singh of Jagdishpur (Bhojpur) led the revolt in Bihar at the age of about 80.

questions.question: In which year was the Quit India Movement launched?
questions.questionHi: भारत छोड़ो आंदोलन किस वर्ष शुरू हुआ?
questions.explanation: The Quit India resolution was passed on 8 August 1942 in Bombay ('Do or Die').

questions.question: Which is the longest river of India?
questions.questionHi: भारत की सबसे लंबी नदी कौन-सी है?
questions.explanation: The Ganga (about 2,525 km) is the longest river flowing within India.

questions.question: Which river is known as the 'Sorrow of Bihar'?
questions.questionHi: किस नदी को 'बिहार का शोक' कहा जाता है?
questions.explanation: The Kosi frequently changes its course and causes devastating floods, hence the name 'Sorrow of Bihar'.

questions.question: Which is the largest state of India by area?
questions.questionHi: क्षेत्रफल की दृष्टि से भारत का सबसे बड़ा राज्य कौन-सा है?
questions.explanation: Rajasthan (about 3.42 lakh km²) is the largest state by area.

questions.question: The Tropic of Cancer does NOT pass through which of these states?
questions.questionHi: कर्क रेखा इनमें से किस राज्य से होकर नहीं गुजरती?
questions.explanation: The Tropic of Cancer passes through Gujarat, Rajasthan, MP, Chhattisgarh, Jharkhand, West Bengal, Tripura and Mizoram. Bihar lies entirely to its north.

questions.question: Black (regur) soil is most suitable for growing which crop?
questions.questionHi: काली (रेगुर) मिट्टी किस फसल के लिए सबसे उपयुक्त है?
questions.explanation: Black soil retains moisture and is ideal for cotton, which is why it is called black cotton soil.

questions.question: The words 'Socialist' and 'Secular' were added to the Preamble by which Constitutional Amendment?
questions.questionHi: प्रस्तावना में 'समाजवादी' और 'पंथनिरपेक्ष' शब्द किस संविधान संशोधन द्वारा जोड़े गए?
questions.explanation: The 42nd Amendment Act, 1976 added 'Socialist', 'Secular' and 'Integrity' to the Preamble.

questions.question: What is the term of a member of the Rajya Sabha?
questions.questionHi: राज्यसभा के सदस्य का कार्यकाल कितना होता है?
questions.explanation: Rajya Sabha members are elected for 6 years; one-third of them retire every 2 years.

questions.question: Who appoints the Governor of a state?
questions.questionHi: किसी राज्य के राज्यपाल की नियुक्ति कौन करता है?
questions.explanation: Under Article 155, the Governor is appointed by the President.

questions.question: Fundamental Duties are listed in which Article of the Constitution?
questions.questionHi: मौलिक कर्तव्य संविधान के किस अनुच्छेद में दिए गए हैं?
questions.explanation: Article 51A (Part IV-A, added in 1976) lists the Fundamental Duties.

questions.question: From which date was the Goods and Services Tax (GST) implemented in India?
questions.questionHi: भारत में वस्तु एवं सेवा कर (GST) किस तिथि से लागू हुआ?
questions.explanation: GST came into force on 1 July 2017. 8 November 2016 is the date of demonetisation.

questions.question: NITI Aayog replaced which body in 2015?
questions.questionHi: 2015 में नीति आयोग ने किस संस्था का स्थान लिया?
questions.explanation: NITI Aayog replaced the Planning Commission on 1 January 2015.

questions.question: Where is the headquarters of the Reserve Bank of India?
questions.questionHi: भारतीय रिज़र्व बैंक का मुख्यालय कहाँ है?
questions.explanation: The RBI's central office has been in Mumbai since 1937.

questions.question: On which date is 'Bihar Diwas' celebrated every year?
questions.questionHi: 'बिहार दिवस' प्रत्येक वर्ष किस तिथि को मनाया जाता है?
questions.explanation: Bihar was carved out of the Bengal Presidency on 22 March 1912, which is celebrated as Bihar Diwas.

questions.question: In which year was Bihar separated from the Bengal Presidency?
questions.questionHi: बिहार को बंगाल प्रेसिडेंसी से किस वर्ष अलग किया गया?
questions.explanation: The province of Bihar and Orissa was created in 1912; Orissa was separated from Bihar in 1936.

questions.question: Valmiki Tiger Reserve is located in which district of Bihar?
questions.questionHi: वाल्मीकि टाइगर रिज़र्व बिहार के किस जिले में स्थित है?
questions.explanation: Valmiki National Park and Tiger Reserve lies in West Champaran district on the Nepal border; it is Bihar's only tiger reserve.

questions.question: Vikramshila University was founded by which ruler?
questions.questionHi: विक्रमशिला विश्वविद्यालय की स्थापना किस शासक ने की?
questions.explanation: Pala king Dharmapala founded Vikramshila (in present-day Bhagalpur district) in the late 8th century.

questions.question: Which is the state bird of Bihar?
questions.questionHi: बिहार का राजकीय पक्षी कौन-सा है?
questions.explanation: The house sparrow (gauraiya) was declared the state bird of Bihar in 2013.

questions.question: After the November 2025 Bihar Assembly election, who took oath as Chief Minister of Bihar for a record tenth time?
questions.questionHi: नवंबर 2025 के बिहार विधानसभा चुनाव के बाद किसने रिकॉर्ड दसवीं बार बिहार के मुख्यमंत्री पद की शपथ ली?
questions.explanation: Nitish Kumar was sworn in as CM for the tenth time on 20 November 2025 after the NDA's victory.

questions.question: India launched 'Operation Sindoor' in May 2025 in response to which terror attack?
questions.questionHi: भारत ने मई 2025 में 'ऑपरेशन सिंदूर' किस आतंकी हमले के जवाब में शुरू किया?
questions.explanation: Operation Sindoor (7 May 2025) targeted terror infrastructure after the 22 April 2025 Pahalgam attack in Jammu & Kashmir.

questions.question: India won the ICC Champions Trophy 2025 by defeating which team in the final?
questions.questionHi: भारत ने ICC चैंपियंस ट्रॉफी 2025 के फाइनल में किस टीम को हराया?
questions.explanation: India beat New Zealand by 4 wickets in the final at Dubai on 9 March 2025.

questions.question: Chandrayaan-3's Vikram lander made a soft landing near which region of the Moon in August 2023?
questions.questionHi: अगस्त 2023 में चंद्रयान-3 का विक्रम लैंडर चंद्रमा के किस क्षेत्र के पास उतरा?
questions.explanation: On 23 August 2023, India became the first country to soft-land near the lunar south pole; the site is called Shiv Shakti Point.

questions.question: Who wrote the national song 'Vande Mataram'?
questions.questionHi: राष्ट्रीय गीत 'वंदे मातरम्' किसने लिखा?
questions.explanation: 'Vande Mataram' is from Bankim Chandra Chattopadhyay's novel Anandamath (1882). Tagore wrote the national anthem.

questions.question: The classical dance Kuchipudi belongs to which state?
questions.questionHi: शास्त्रीय नृत्य कुचिपुड़ी किस राज्य से संबंधित है?
questions.explanation: Kuchipudi is named after a village in Krishna district, Andhra Pradesh. Kathakali is from Kerala, Odissi from Odisha and Bharatanatyam from Tamil Nadu.

questions.question: Where is the headquarters of the United Nations?
questions.questionHi: संयुक्त राष्ट्र का मुख्यालय कहाँ है?
questions.explanation: The UN headquarters is in New York City, USA.
